title: Food and Nutrition
seo_title: Year 3 Science: Food and Nutrition Worksheets (Balanced Diet and Food Groups)
standard_text: Identify that animals, including humans, need the right types and amount of nutrition, and that they cannot make their own food; they get nutrition from what they eat.
meta_desc: Free Year 3 science worksheets on food and nutrition: animals cannot make their own food, herbivores, carnivores and omnivores, the Eatwell Guide, nutrients and balanced meals. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Animals must eat to get nutrition.
key_sub: Eat the right types and amounts of food.
body_html:
How to think about it

Animals cannot make their own food. They get nutrition from what they eat.

  • Herbivores eat plants, carnivores eat animals, omnivores eat both. Humans are omnivores.
  • Different foods give different nutrients. The Eatwell Guide shows how much of each food group to eat.
  • A balanced diet has the right types and the right amounts of food.
Example

Can a rabbit make its own food?

It is an animal

Answer: No, it eats plants

Example

Pasta: which food group?

Starchy food

Answer: potatoes, bread, rice, pasta

Common mistakes

  • Thinking animals make food like plants.
  • Thinking one food has everything you need.
  • Thinking fat is always bad.

faq.q: Why can't animals make their own food?
faq.a: Only plants can make food using sunlight in their leaves. Animals must eat plants or other animals to get the nutrition they need.
Eating the right types of food in the right amounts: plenty of fruit, vegetables and starchy foods, some protein and dairy, and only a little oil, fat and sugar.
The Eatwell Guide has fruit and vegetables; potatoes, bread, rice and pasta; beans, fish, eggs and meat; dairy and alternatives; and oils and spreads.
